title: Paloma Business Plan Downgrades and the Early Termination Fee
content:
A downgrade the owner of a Paloma Business account schedules before the commitment end date carries an early termination charge, taken from the balance as an early termination fee on the day the downgrade is scheduled; the downgrade itself still takes effect on the first day of the next billing period.

### When the charge is fixed

The early termination charge of a downgrade is fixed only after the account carries no subscription charge still owed for a billing period that has already started.

Put the other way round: while the account still owes a subscription charge for a billing period that has already started, the early termination charge of a downgrade is not yet fixed.

### Business effect of scheduling

| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| Lower plan | Recorded on the account as the scheduled plan, with the date it takes effect |
| Date the lower plan takes effect | The first day of the next billing period |
| Early termination charge | Booked as one early termination fee entry for the current billing period on the day the downgrade is scheduled, and taken off the balance |

### Tool: `schedule_plan_downgrade_6c5bcb1c`

**Capability.** The business owner schedules their own Paloma Business account to move to a lower plan and pays the early termination charge for leaving the committed plan early. One call records the lower plan and the date it takes effect on the account, books one early termination fee entry for the current billing period with the amount given, and takes that amount off the business balance. Afterwards the owner sees the scheduled plan and change date on the account and the early termination fee on the balance history, and the lower plan applies from the change date.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `business_account_id` | The Paloma Business account reference number of the owner's account, as returned by the Paloma Business account lookup | Identifier |
| `lower_plan` | The official name of the lower plan the owner moves to | One of the enumerated plan names below |
| `change_date` | The date the lower plan takes effect | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `early_termination_fee_usd` | The early termination charge being paid | USD, a non-negative amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

Enumerated values of `lower_plan`:
- `Paloma Business Starter`: the owner moves down to the Starter plan;
- `Paloma Business Essentials`: the owner moves down to the Essentials plan;
- `Paloma Business Growth`: the owner moves down to the Growth plan;
- `Paloma Business Pro`: the owner moves down to the Pro plan;
- `Paloma Business Scale`: the owner moves down to the Scale plan from Enterprise;
- `Paloma Business Enterprise`: never lower than another plan, so not used for a downgrade.

**Return.** A text receipt of a dictionary with `ledger_entry_id` (reference of the early termination fee entry booked), `business_account_id` (the account), `scheduled_plan` (the lower plan now scheduled), `scheduled_change_date` (YYYY-MM-DD date it takes effect), `early_termination_fee_usd` (USD charged, 2 decimals) and `balance_usd` (resulting USD balance, 2 decimals). A `scheduled_plan` equal to the chosen plan indicates the downgrade is scheduled.
